test: student KIO submission approved on backend A and started on backend B
environment: isolated local Compose project; PostgreSQL 16; two independent backend processes with distinct BACKEND_NODE_ID values; repository backend source mounted into both; direct loopback HTTP/WS endpoints; disposable synthetic users/group/session
scenario_flow: create trainee KIO submission through backend-a
approve submission as owning instructor through backend-a
without any scenario request to backend-b, send scenario.start over backend-b control WebSocket
receive the approved student KIO on backend-b station WebSocket
read the newly approved scenario from backend-b instructor catalog and detail API
scope_limits: This proves cross-process PostgreSQL sharing and cache-miss resolution for a published student scenario, including the DDS handoff and user-facing catalog/detail APIs. It does not exercise Nginx consistent-hash routing, node failure during this flow, target hardware, or concurrent publication/read races.
